description: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike, backed entirely by remote sources through Gelato. No local media is assumed. Own auth/session runtime and directly rendered screens, not a reskin of native jellyfin-web components.
name: Jellio
overview: Replaces the Jellyfin web client's own rendering with a Nuvio lookalike.

## [0.88.4] - 2026-09-03

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Let git-cliff read squash merged commit bullets for release versioning

### 💼 Other

- Sleep timer episode mode, popover positioning, notifications hover, SubDL cache fix (#221)
- * fix: do not cache a SubDL request failure as a 28 day not-found
- SearchAsync used to return null on any non 2xx status, indistinguishable
- From a genuine empty search result. A bad api_key or blocked account
- Then got cached by SaveNotFound the same as a real miss, silently
- Retrying nothing for 28 days even after being fixed.
- SearchAsync now throws SubDlRequestFailedException with the real status
- Code instead, and EnsureAsync catches it separately, logging without
- Touching the cache. Also logs the two previously silent success paths
- (found, genuinely not found) so a real SubDL run is distinguishable in
- The server log from this whole method never firing at all.
- * fix: log when kicking off a subtitle fetch fails
- EnsureSubtitles(itemId) used to swallow every outcome silently. The
- Actual fetch result still only ever shows up in the Jellyfin server log
- By design (it runs detached server side), but a failure of the kickoff
- POST itself is a real client side event worth a console line.
- * fix: open playback speed and sleep timer popovers near their own button
- Every player popover shared one fixed right anchor in app.css, so all
- Of them opened in the same spot regardless of which pill button was
- Actually clicked. That only ever looked right for Audio; Speed sits at
- The pill's own left edge and opened on the opposite side of the screen.
- Popovers now position themselves off the real clicked button's own
- Bounding rect at open time, clamped to the player shell's own bounds.
- * feat: add an episode count mode to the sleep timer
- Alongside the existing duration options, Sleep can now be set to stop
- After a chosen number of episodes instead. Counted down from the same
- Client side Up Next trigger an episode boundary already fires, and
- Implemented by calling the same dismissUpNext used when a reader
- Dismisses Up Next by hand, which already ends playback without
- Auto-advancing, rather than adding a second stop mechanism.
- * feat: make the notifications panel hover sensitive like now playing
- Notifications used to only ever open and close on click. Mirrors
- Components/nowPlaying.js's own hover behaviour: opens on mouseenter over
- The sidebar button, and closes on a short delay after the pointer
- Leaves both the button and the panel, while still supporting a plain
- Click for touch and keyboard.
- Let git-cliff read squash merged commit bullets for release versioning
